result.reason: The operative language fully achieves the preferred position by removing the sole-provider obligation and expressly confirming that Customer has no exclusivity or minimum-sourcing commitment. The revision is narrowly focused on exclusivity, is consistent with Section 12.3, preserves unrelated commercial terms, and is professionally drafted. Although somewhat duplicative of Section 12.3, the replacement appropriately resolves the direct contradiction created by the original Section 2.2.
